name: Off-Road Vehicle
description: A motor-driven off-road recreation vehicle capable of cross-country travel without a road or trail, explicitly including motorcycles and related two-wheeled vehicles, so an off-road electric dirt bike is an ORV. Licensed with the Department of Natural Resources.

restrictions.rule: Capable of cross-country travel over natural terrain; includes motorcycles and related two-wheeled vehicles, with no limit on power or speed
Licensed with the DNR or a dealer to ride on natural terrain, forest trails or designated areas, except on private property by the owner, family or invited guests, and on free ORV-riding days
Riders under 16 must hold an ORV safety certificate and be under an adult's direct visual supervision

Every rider and passenger must wear a DOT-approved crash helmet and protective eyewear, except on one's own or a host's private property (riders under 16 always, and 16 or 17 without a parent's consent)
Kept off streets, county roads and highways unless registered for the road or riding where ORV use is authorized
Ridden on another's land only with the written consent of the owner where required
A headlight and taillight are required from half an hour after sunset to half an hour before sunrise
